# BridgingFX — llms.txt

> BridgingFX provides white-label trading platforms, Forex CRM software, liquidity,
> prop-firm technology, and launch-to-scale services for forex brokers, prop firms,
> and financial institutions. Based in Dubai, UAE.

## Company

- [About BridgingFX](https://bridgingfx.net/about) — Who BridgingFX is and how it works with brokers, prop firms, and financial institutions.
- [Contact](https://bridgingfx.net/contact) — Book a discovery call or send an enquiry.
- [Blog](https://bridgingfx.net/blog) — Editorial insights: launching brokerages, white-label platforms, prop-firm technology, FX industry analysis.
- [FAQ](https://bridgingfx.net/faq) — Answers about white-label timelines, platforms, licensing, CRM, migrations, prop firms, and packages.
- [Sitemap](https://bridgingfx.net/sitemap.xml) — Full page list.

## Core offerings

- [White-Label Platforms](https://bridgingfx.net/platforms) — cTrader, Wintrado, Hybrid (cTrader + Wintrado), TM9, and MT4/MT5 white labels.
- [Forex CRM — BridgeX](https://bridgingfx.net/crm) — Customizable Forex CRM: leads, funds, accounts, IB/affiliate systems, compliance; cloud or self-hosted.
- [Prop-Firm Technology](https://bridgingfx.net/prop-firms) — Challenge and evaluation tech (1-step, 2-step, instant funding), risk monitoring, trader dashboards, scaling plans, payout workflows.
- [Company Formation](https://bridgingfx.net/company-formation) — Forex company registration, jurisdiction and licensing guidance, plus launch services.
- [Launch Packages](https://bridgingfx.net/packages) — Three tiers: Start-Up Accelerator (Entry), Growth Catalyst (Professional, recommended), Enterprise Institution (Elite); upgrades supported.
